questions.stem: 在贊助群眾募資（crowdfunding）的計畫之前，許多人會先上網查看發起人過去做過的事。
questions.answer: Before supporting a crowdfunding project, many people first go online to check what its creators have done in the past.
accepted_answers: Before backing a crowdfunding project, many people will first search online to find out what the creators have done in the past.
Before giving money to a crowdfunding project, many people first look online to see what its creators have done in the past.

patterns: 連接詞＋分詞（Before + V-ing：在贊助…之前）
what 名詞子句（發起人過去做過的事＝what its creators have done）

questions.stem: 相較於向銀行借錢，群眾募資（crowdfunding）讓更多人有機會實現夢想，不論他們的背景為何。
questions.answer: Compared with taking out bank loans, crowdfunding offers more people the opportunity to fulfill their dreams, no matter what their backgrounds are.
accepted_answers: Compared with borrowing money from banks, crowdfunding gives more people a chance to realize their dreams, no matter what their backgrounds are.
In comparison with borrowing from a bank, crowdfunding allows more people to make their dreams come true, no matter what their background is.

patterns: 讓步：無論…（no matter what：不論他們的背景為何）
相較於…（比較片語＋比較級 more people）

1.explanation_zh: 「在贊助…之前」和主要子句的主詞都是「許多人」，可以用連接詞＋分詞 Before supporting a crowdfunding project, …；before 在這裡當介系詞，後面接動名詞。「上網查看」是 go online to check（online 是副詞，不加 to）。「發起人過去做過的事」沒有必要譯出「事」，用 what 名詞子句 what its creators have done in the past 當 check 的受詞，子句內用直述句語序。
evidence: 在贊助群眾募資（crowdfunding）的計畫之前
1.strategy_zh: 先確認「贊助」和「查看」是同一群人做的，才能用 Before + V-ing；受詞「…做過的事」用 what 子句。
hints: 切成四段：在贊助／群眾募資的計畫／許多人會先上網查看／發起人過去做過的事
標的詞彙：support（贊助）、project（計畫、案子）、online（在網路上）、creator（發起人）、past（過去）
句型框架：Before + V-ing …, S + V + to VR + what + S + have p.p. …

2.explanation_zh: 「相較於向銀行借錢」用 Compared with taking out bank loans 或 Compared with borrowing money from banks（with 後接動名詞；「向…借」是 borrow from）。主要子句要帶出比較：crowdfunding offers more people the opportunity to fulfill their dreams（或 gives more people a chance to realize their dreams）。句尾「不論他們的背景為何」是讓步，用 no matter what their backgrounds are，no matter what 後面是直述句語序。
evidence: 讓更多人有機會實現夢想
2.strategy_zh: 句首比較片語、中間主要子句（記得有 more）、句尾 no matter 子句，三段各自檢查語序。
hints: 切成四段：相較於向銀行借錢／群眾募資讓更多人有機會／實現夢想／不論他們的背景為何
標的詞彙：compare（比較）、bank（銀行）、dream（夢想）、background（背景）
句型框架：Compared with + V-ing …, S + give + more + N + a chance to VR …, no matter what + S + V

traps.literal_error: Before supporting a crowdfunding plan, many people first go online to check …
traps.explanation_zh: 「群眾募資的計畫」是正在募款的案子，英文用 project／campaign；plan 指「打算、規劃」，搭配不對。

traps.literal_error: many people first go online to check its creators' past done things
traps.explanation_zh: 中文把「發起人過去做過的」放在「事」前面；英文要改成 what 名詞子句 what its creators have done in the past。

bonus.text: Only after checking what the creators have achieved in the past do many people decide to back a crowdfunding project.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 Only after + V-ing + 助動詞 + S + V 的倒裝，強調「先查過才贊助」；只當加分寫法。

1.restructuring_zh: 「發起人過去做過的事」中文把修飾語放在「事」前面，英文改寫成 what 名詞子句 what its creators have done in the past；「在贊助…之前」的主詞和主要子句相同（許多人），可簡化成 Before + V-ing。

1.translation: Before supporting a crowdfunding project, many people will first go online to check what its organizer has done in the past.
1.explanation_zh: 「在…之前」用介系詞＋V-ing（Before supporting）；「發起人過去做過的事」用 what 名詞子句當 check 的受詞；「贊助」用 support（也可用 fund、back）；「發起人」譯 organizer（也可 creator、founder）。

2.translation: Compared with borrowing money from banks, crowdfunding gives more people a chance to make their dreams come true, no matter what their backgrounds are.
2.explanation_zh: 「相較於向銀行借錢」用 Compared with＋V-ing；「讓更多人有機會」用 give sb a chance to；「不論他們的背景為何」用 no matter what 讓步子句（也可 regardless of their backgrounds）。

issues_zh: 第 4 部分「發起人過去做過的事」的 accepted 都是複數（creators、founders、the people behind it），沒有單數的 what its creator/organizer has done in the past；中文「發起人」不分單複數，單數一樣正確（我的盲譯用 its organizer has done）。target_words 已把 organizer、founder 列為 alternatives，accepted 也應補單數寫法。
標的句型標成 PART（gp-conj-participle，「連接詞＋分詞」），但第 1 部分常見錯誤的說明寫「before 在這裡是介系詞，後面接動名詞 supporting」，兩處對 Before + V-ing 的分析不一致；建議統一說法（或改用 PREPVING）。

issues_zh: 「不論他們的背景為何」我譯成 regardless of their backgrounds（介系詞片語，accepted 有收），沒有用 no matter what 子句，所以 ADVCL（S + V …, no matter what + S + V）沒被引出；中文不限定要用子句。
